utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — let me know the time, and I can help with pickup and drop-off if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Sam — I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time. Pickup and drop-off help would be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey — thanks for checking in with folks. If you find anything missing, just let me know and I can lend a tool.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing, Gus. I’ll check in with folks and let you know if I find anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be here if you need a tool or two for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need and put together a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That would help a lot. Please send me the list and the time to meet, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll send over the list and a meeting time as soon as I finish checking what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’d be great—could you help spread the word too? I’m a bit behind, but I can check the supply list and catch up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I can help spread the word, and I’ll fill you in on the supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye—that really helps. Send me the supply list when you can, and I’ll do my best to catch up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs first—what’s broken, and do we already have a supply list?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the list, but I’m a bit tied up today. If you already have the broken items noted, I can check what supplies are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that would help—can you check what’s been gathered and tell me the missing supplies? Once we know that, we can sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds like a great mix of jobs — I can help spread the word and connect people to the right tasks. If you share the list, I’ll point folks toward the repairs they can handle.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll see you a bit later and help wherever I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an eye out for the list and match folks up as it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s mostly little fixes—patching, painting, and a few broken bits folks have been meaning to handle. I’m just trying to round up help and see who can pitch in where.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll check the latest repair list and see what’s missing. Can you also tell me if the donated tools are all accounted for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by and check on the tools later today, and I’ll let you know if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — I’m still checking the list so we don’t miss anything for the repair drive. If we’re short on tools, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia — just let me know what’s still needed, and I’ll help keep track of where it all needs to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Opal — I’ll finish checking the list and then I’ll send you the gaps. That should help us keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s what I heard too — still on this afternoon, with donations and tools being collected. I’m still catching up, though, so let me know if anything changed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — I just wanted to make sure it’s still on.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts over by the community center today. If you’ve got anything to spare, that’s the place to take it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll send the list over shortly and stop by the community center if I can spare anything. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your list, and the community center is the spot if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m already spreading the word, and I can add your name to the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn. Add me to the list, and I’ll keep checking what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it, Leo — I’ll put your name down and keep folks posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, quick update—the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you need anything from me to help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’m happy to help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep everything organized and let you know what I need as we get closer to Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work well—3:30 is perfect after pickup. Do you want me to help spread the word to the other parents?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that would be really helpful. I’m still catching up, so the more folks who hear it, the better.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can help spread the word to the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Pia — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I can help keep things organized for it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — that helps a lot. I’m still checking the list so we don’t miss anything, and I’ll let you know if we’re short on tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — I appreciate it. Just send me the updated list when you have it, and I’ll help make sure everything’s set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s still on this afternoon, and it’s mostly little fixes like patching and painting. I’ll stop by later and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. See you this afternoon then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help a little if you still need someone; just let me know where to put me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great — I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, then I’ll let you know where you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll be ready whenever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still happy to help. I can take on pickup and drop-off if that’s useful.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be really helpful, Sam—pickup and drop-off would save us a lot of time. I’m just catching up, so if there’s a supply list, point me to it and I’ll see where I can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can point you to the supply list and help with pickup and drop-off. Just send me what’s needed, and I’ll jump in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what we still need and put together a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll wait for your list and then we can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll pull that together and let you know what’s missing soon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to keep track of the locations for the repair drive—what place are we starting with?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s start with the community hall first—can you note that as our first stop?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — community hall is our first stop. What’s the next location?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll keep an eye on the donated tools and let you know if anything’s missing. Just point me to where you need me for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. Could you help keep the tool table organized near the intake area, and I’ll line up the pickup shift?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll stay by the intake area and keep the tool table in order. Just let me know if you need me to flag anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s the one — I’m heading over with a few tools myself. If you’ve got anything to spare, the community center’s the place to take it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can spread the word and see if anyone nearby has extra tools to bring by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Much appreciated, Jules—every extra tool helps. I’ll be at the community center if anyone needs to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—last I heard, it’s still going on, and they’re collecting donations and tools for the fixes. I might’ve missed a change or two, though.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll still plan to be there around 2 to help sort and load. If anything changed on what’s needed, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep an ear out for any updates and let you know if I hear anything different.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like the latest list, if you have it. Clear plans help me bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m still passing it around, and I can put your name on the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—please add me to the list. If you get the latest items, I’d appreciate a quick rundown so I can come prepared.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What’s been gathered so far, and what supplies are still missing? Once I know that, I can help sort the urgent repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll send over the list shortly — offhand, we’ve got a few basics, but I still need to check what’s missing. Thanks for helping sort the urgent ones first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — send the list when you can, and I’ll help prioritize the urgent repairs.
